messages.subject: MRDS model not converging & Point independence issue
parts:
Dear all,

I am having two issues with the MRDS engine in Distance 6.0.

1) The first one relates to the incorporation of interaction terms inside=
my MR model=20
definition. I have defined and successfully run a set of FI models (with =
only main effects).=20
Like in the Golf Tees sample project, I wanted to test a couple of conten=
ding models with=20
interaction terms, but depending on the covariates I want interacting, Di=
stance sometimes=20
returns the following error message:

-------------------------------------------------------------------------=
-----------------------
> > ddf.21<-
ddf(method=3D'io.fi',mrmodel=3D~glm(link=3D'logit',formula=3D~distance+se=
a.state*glare),data=3D
ddf.dat.21,meta.data=3Dlist(width=3D7.01943))

[1] "Can't calculate regression coefficients - model has not converged"
[1] " - last fit used for estimation"

Error in int[p !=3D 0] <- width - log(1 + b[p !=3D 0] * exp(p[p !=3D 0] *=
width))/p[p !=3D :=20

NAs are not allowed in subscripted assignments
Calls: ddf ... pdot.dsr.integrate.logistic -> integratelogistic.analytic
In addition: Warning message:

In predict.lm(object, newdata, se.fit, scale =3D 1, type =3D ifelse(type =
=3D=3D :

prediction from a rank-deficient fit may be misleading
Execution halted

-----------------------

Any idea why the model is not converging ? Have I set up my data wrong ?

2) The other issue I am facing concerns the use of PI models. So far, all=
the models I=20
have tested are FI ones (with an independent observer configuration). Nat=
urally my next=20
step would be to see whether relaxing the full independence assumption ca=
n reduce=20
possible bias. However, when I try out the PI models, Distance returns an=
error message=20
of the following type, irrespective of the covariates I use or the nature=
of the DS model:

-------------------------------------------------------------------------=
-----------------------
> > plot(ddf.22,lwd=3D2,lty=3D1,pch=3D1,cex=3D1)
Error in plot.io(ddf.22, lwd =3D 2, lty =3D 1, pch =3D 1, cex =3D 1) :=20=

dims [product 250] do not match the length of object [257]
Calls: plot -> plot.io
In addition: Warning messages:

:

longer object length is not a multiple of shorter object length
Execution halted

-------------------------------------------------------------------------=
-----------------------

however some plots are obviously missing. Anyone knows what [product 250]=

[257] refer to ?

messages.author: 5140016d70f6ba82
messages.subject: Re: MRDS model not converging & Point independence issue
parts:
If the problem is levels with missing data, you can fit the full
interaction model by creating another factor variable that concatenates
the two variables (eg seastate and glare) and fit a model with that
factor variable. It will have levels where have you have data. Now it
could also be that one of the interactions has too few data and that is
causing the lack of convergence. If that is the case, then you may have
to collapse levels to get the model to converge.
regards --jeff
